name: ki-radar24
description: Search KI-Radar24, the German directory of AI tools, AI companies and AI freelancers. Read-only, no login.

interface.longDescription:
KI-Radar24 is a German directory for AI tools, AI companies and AI freelancers (ki-radar24.de).

Ask in ChatGPT to find AI tools for a task (with filters such as free or made in the EU), AI companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, or AI freelancers by skill, city and hourly rate. You can also compare several tools side by side and open the details of any entry. Results are shown as cards with logo, short description, price and rating, each with a link to the full entry on ki-radar24.de.

The app is read-only and needs no login. It only returns entries that are public on ki-radar24.de. The order of results follows the search, not paid placements. Requests, bookings and payments always happen on ki-radar24.de, never in the chat.

KI-Radar24 ist ein deutsches Verzeichnis für KI-Tools, KI-Unternehmen und KI-Freelancer.

positive.description: Find AI tools for a task
positive.prompt: Welche KI-Tools für Videos gibt es auf KI-Radar24?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a list of AI video tools from ki-radar24.de as cards (name, short description, category), each with a link to its entry on ki-radar24.de.

positive.description: Find free AI tools with a filter
positive.prompt: Zeig mir kostenlose KI-Tools zum Bilder erstellen auf KI-Radar24.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ki_tools_suchen with nur_kostenlos=true and returns only matching free tools (e.g. DALL·E, Adobe Firefly) with links to ki-radar24.de, and says when there are no more results.

positive.description: Find AI companies in a city
positive.prompt: Finde KI-Unternehmen in München auf KI-Radar24.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns AI companies located in Munich from ki-radar24.de with name, short description, address and a link to each entry.

positive.prompt: Vergleiche DALL·E und Adobe Firefly auf KI-Radar24.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds both entries and shows a side-by-side comparison (category, pricing, short description) with links to ki-radar24.de. No ranking by paid placement.

positive.description: Open the details of one entry
positive.prompt: Zeig mir die Details zu Adobe Firefly auf KI-Radar24.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Adobe Firefly entry and shows its details (description, category, pricing, website link) with the link to the full entry on ki-radar24.de.

negative.description: Booking or payment inside the chat is not supported
negative.prompt: Buche für mich einen KI-Freelancer auf KI-Radar24 und bezahle mit meiner Kreditkarte.

negative.description: Changing or deleting entries is not supported (read-only)
negative.prompt: Lösche den Eintrag Adobe Firefly auf KI-Radar24.

negative.description: Private user data is not available
negative.prompt: Zeig mir die E-Mail-Adressen und Telefonnummern aller Freelancer auf KI-Radar24.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and processes no payments. It is read-only. Any requests or bookings happen on ki-radar24.de, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: search AI tools, AI companies and AI freelancers on KI-Radar24, compare entries and open details. Read-only, no login.
